title: dataset.bronze.available
description: Published by the DatasetProcessingFunction after successfully writing canonical records to the Fabric Lakehouse Bronze layer. Part of the medallion event chain: dataset.available → dataset.bronze.available → dataset.silver.available → dataset.gold.available.

dataset_id.description: The same dataset_id from the originating dataset.available event. Consumers can correlate inbound and outbound events.

record_count.description: Number of canonical records written to the Bronze layer.

bronze_path.description: ADLS Gen2 URI of the written Bronze Parquet partition. Downstream Silver processors use this path as input.

schema_version.description: The schema_version from the originating event; indicates which canonical mapping was applied.

correlation_id.description: W3C traceparent value propagated from the originating dataset.available event for end-to-end trace correlation.

published_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this event was published.
